scope: retrospective test of published compressed observables; no catalogue-level blindness

candidate.linear_mode: adiabatic growing conserved clustering dust in GR; smooth Lambda, scale-independent growth

WiggleZ.locator: post-reconstruction middle bin; abstract and sections 4.3-4.5

target.survey: eBOSS DR16 QSO consensus, Hou et al. equations 49-52

rule.primary: single joint Gaussian compression test Q=r^T[3(C_QSO+B_BAO+B_RSD)]^-1 r, reject if Q exceeds chi2(3) 95th percentile; unknown correlations among three survey errors allowed
rule.sector_diagnostics: background and growth tests at alpha/2 each, reported separately from primary
rule.independence_diagnostic: also compute full joint chi2 under zero cross-survey covariance; never select the smaller p value for the primary verdict
rule.positive_control: inject a ten-worst-case-sigma shift in the growth component of noiseless predictions; must reject
